dense: cosine of mean vectors; zero query returns nothing; only scores > 0 returned
hybrid: RRF offset 60 over positive BM25 and authored dense lists; omitted candidates contribute zero
reranker: Rule, not neural: stable partition top-three hybrid candidates by inferred topic/date eligibility; no relevance-label access
ties: Round score to 12 decimals for comparison, then KA-0 A–E order; full float64 used otherwise
metrics: Recall@2 and nDCG@2; full returned-list reciprocal rank; macro excludes eight-answerable denominator empty gold; empty-gold abstention separately
